title: Hermes Agent Hub
tagline: Personal AI agent system with code intelligence + multi-source knowledge
audience: Devs outside the Tailscale ring who want to understand or replicate this architecture

brain_bridge.name: Brain Bridge
brain_bridge.purpose: MCP server exposing 18 knowledge tools - wikis, ChromaDB, Mnemosyne, Logseq, web search, contradictions registry
brain_bridge.best_for: Ask anything about user's personal knowledge base

unified_memory.name: Unified Memory
unified_memory.purpose: Cross-source FTS5 search across 10 memory databases
unified_memory.best_for: Fast keyword search across emails, notes, sessions, learnings

hermes_api.name: Hermes API
hermes_api.purpose: OpenAI-compatible HTTP API exposing the full agent - works with Open WebUI, custom clients, multi-provider LLM routing
hermes_api.best_for: Building external apps that need agent capabilities

codegraph.name: CodeGraph
codegraph.purpose: Codebase intelligence - parses code into nodes/edges graph, answers 'what calls X', 'what does X affect', file structure queries
commands: codegraph callees <symbol> - what does X call
codegraph impact <symbol> - blast radius of changes
codegraph affected [files] - test files affected by source changes
codegraph serve --mcp - start MCP server for agent
codegraph install - wire MCP into any agent (Claude/Cursor/Codex/Hermes/Gemini/Kiro/Copilot)
codegraph.best_for: Understanding or modifying a large unfamiliar codebase - replaces grep + reading every file

understand_anything.name: Understand Anything
how_it_uses_hermes_hub: Phase 1-3 uses CodeGraph to enumerate files + relationships instead of parsing from scratch
Phase 4-7 stores summary graph in `.ua/` directory; surface frontmatter readable via Brain Bridge wiki_search
Outputs `knowledge-graph.json` that Hermes can navigate via Unified Memory

use_cases.path: Read this site, then clone repo

use_cases.wants: Use CodeGraph on their own codebase

use_cases.path: Connect to API port 8642 with VILAO_CTG_KEY

replication_steps: 2. Install CodeGraph: `brew tap obot-platform/tap && brew install codegraph`
5. Index your notes: configure `wiki_paths` in Brain Bridge env
6. Optional: stand up Mnemosyne for vector memory
7. Optional: install Understand Anything for graph-style onboarding
